_comment: Demo trips for Safar Saathi. Loaded by the backend's seed loader when the database has no trips yet.
Everything here is invented demo data: airlines (IndiJet IJ, SkyMitra SM), hotels, bookings and references.
Trips get database ids in file order on an empty database: trip 1 = business demo, trip 2 = Marathi holiday demo.
Blocks and links get ids in file order too (trip 1 blocks first, then trip 2).
Times are relative so the demo never goes stale: 'day' = days after the trip day, 'start'/'end' = HH:mm in
Asia/Kolkata. 'endDay' defaults to 'day'. The trip day = today + safarsaathi.seed.day-offset (default 1 = tomorrow).
Links point at blocks by their 'key'. A link means: 'to' may start at least minGapMinutes + travelMinutes
after 'from' ends. freeChangeUntilMinutes is an offset from the block's start (-30 = free changes until
30 minutes before it starts); null = no free-change window (a fee always applies, see changeFeeInr).
Enum values must match CLAUDE.md section 3 exactly.

blocks.title: Flight IJ 512 Mumbai to Bengaluru
blocks.notes: Arrives at Bengaluru T1 (BLR). Change fee 2,500 rupees, waived when the airline causes the disruption.

blocks.title: Collect bags at Bengaluru T1
blocks.notes: About 20 minutes from landing to bags in hand.

blocks.title: Cab pickup to the Whitefield office
blocks.notes: Free pickup change until 30 minutes before pickup, 200 rupees after. Ride to Whitefield takes about 75 minutes.

blocks.title: Client meeting in Whitefield
blocks.locationName: Client office, ITPL Main Road, Whitefield
blocks.notes: The reason for the trip (anchor). Moving it needs the traveller's OK; a video call is a possible fallback.

blocks.title: Hotel check-in: Whitefield Residency
blocks.notes: Check-in is a window, a late-arrival note is always allowed. Free cancellation until 24 hours before check-in. From the airport it is about 60 minutes by cab. Check-out tomorrow 11:00.

blocks.title: Team dinner at Tandoor House
blocks.notes: Free change or cancel until 18:00 on the day.

blocks.title: Flight SM 231 Pune to Delhi
blocks.notes: First flight for this traveller (58). Arrives at Delhi T3 (DEL). Same booking as the Leh flight.

blocks.title: Flight SM 445 Delhi to Leh
blocks.notes: Connection at Delhi: at least 75 minutes between flights. Arrives at Leh (IXL), 3,500 m above sea level.

blocks.title: Collect bags at Leh airport
blocks.notes: Walk slowly and drink water: the air is thin at Leh.

blocks.title: Cab pickup to the hotel
blocks.notes: Free pickup change until 30 minutes before pickup, 200 rupees after. About 20 minutes to the hotel.

blocks.title: Hotel check-in: Indus View Guest House
blocks.locationName: Indus View Guest House, Changspa, Leh
blocks.notes: Rest for the whole first day (altitude). Free cancellation until 24 hours before check-in. 3 nights.
